description: Right hand: a finger gun pointing up, held without releasing for about 25 s (engages at 1.6 s), turned in different ways (twisting the palm to face away and back, about 120-150 degrees; tilting; turning sideways) and brought back to the same starting orientation between turns, pausing there. Turning fast, motion blur makes the index look curled for 20-40 ms at a time. Released at about 26.7 s. Recorded from a live webcam at 640x480 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data, every other frame (~37 fps); labels are as the tracker sees them.
